newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 886 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 886 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 886 contracts compared with 1,104 overnight Tuesday.
There were 110 wheat, 478 corn, 232 soybean, 36 soymeal, 10 soyoil, four wheat calls, three wheat puts, 12 soybean calls and one soybean put traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1/4 cent higher to 2-1/4 cents lower, corn was steady to 1/4 cent lower and soybeans were steady to two cents lower.
